descricao_original: Each ovary is both an exocrine (production of oocytes) and an endocrine (production of estrogen and progesterone) organ. The gland can be divided into an outer cortex and inner medulla. The exterior of the ovary is covered by a serosa with a simple cuboidal epithelium (mesothelium) overlying a band of dense connective tissue, the tunica albuginea. 10x
creditos_identificados: Image source: This image is taken of a slide in the University of Mississippi collection.
